table_mode: All owned tables are SQLite STRICT, use opaque UUIDv4 internal identity, explicit revision checks, LLD-01 command-receipt provenance and effective FK indexes.

tables.name: product_lines
columns: product_line_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
name TEXT NOT NULL
lifecycle_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(lifecycle_state IN ('active','archived'))
revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0)
created_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(created_at_utc>=0)
created_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
last_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: equal names do not establish identity
archived Product Line cannot receive a new active CPL

tables.name: contracts
columns: contract_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
customer_org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customer_organizations(customer_org_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
name TEXT NOT NULL
contract_reference TEXT NOT NULL
lifecycle_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(lifecycle_state IN ('active','archived'))
revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0)
created_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(created_at_utc>=0)
created_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
last_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: belongs to exactly one Customer Organization
archival is blocked when it would strand current classifications/CPL obligations

tables.name: contract_product_lines
columns: contract_product_line_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
contract_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES contracts(contract_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
product_line_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES product_lines(product_line_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
lifecycle_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(lifecycle_state IN ('active','archived'))
current_policy_revision_id TEXT NULL
revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0)
created_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(created_at_utc>=0)
created_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
last_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: same Product Line may occur in multiple Contracts including same Customer
no unique contract/product-line pair is imposed because separate occurrences under one Contract may be required by explicit agreement identity; duplicate-looking creation is reviewed
new active SR classification requires lifecycle_state=active and a current accepted policy

tables.name: sla_classification_mappings
columns: mapping_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
mapping_key_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mapping_key_type='customer_account_code')
normalized_key TEXT NOT NULL
customer_org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customer_organizations(customer_org_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
contract_product_line_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES contract_product_lines(contract_product_line_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
active INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(active IN (0,1))
revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0)
created_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(created_at_utc>=0)
opened_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
closed_command_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: trusted mapping key is explicit Customer Account Code only in Beta 1.0
multiple active mappings for one Customer/key are representable and therefore AMBIGUOUS; they never auto-select
mapped CPL Contract must belong to customer_org_id and be active at use time

tables.name: sr_classification_events
columns: classification_event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
service_request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES service_requests(service_request_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
event_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_kind IN ('assign','reclassify','invalidate_customer','clear'))
prior_contract_product_line_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES contract_product_lines(contract_product_line_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
new_contract_product_line_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES contract_product_lines(contract_product_line_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(origin IN ('manual_review','automatic_mapping','batch_review','customer_correction'))
mapping_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES sla_classification_mappings(mapping_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
reason_code TEXT NULL
recorded_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(recorded_at_utc>=0)
command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: automatic_mapping requires mapping_id and unique current mapping proof

tables.name: sr_classification_current
columns: service_request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES service_requests(service_request_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
contract_product_line_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES contract_product_lines(contract_product_line_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
classification_event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES sr_classification_events(classification_event_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0)
last_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: row represents current valid Customer-compatible classification only
Customer correction that makes it incompatible removes current row and appends invalidation event in same governed transaction

required_indexes: all command/FK columns receive LLD-01 leading-prefix FK coverage
cross_customer_guard: Any assignment/reclassification/automatic mapping must prove inside the current UnitOfWork that ServiceRequestSlaInputReader resolves one Customer, the target CPL is active, its Contract is active, and Contract.customer_org_id exactly equals that resolved Customer. Otherwise classification is rejected or remains unclassified.
